settings.title: Intake and identity check
settings.text: Every device is logged, checked for authenticity, matched to its key specifications and reviewed for any visible wear before work begins.

settings.title: Full diagnostics
settings.text: We test the core hardware and software features that matter most, including display, buttons, cameras, connectivity, sensors and overall responsiveness.

settings.title: Repair and restoration
settings.text: Any approved component work, updates and restoration tasks are completed so the device is ready for dependable everyday use.

settings.title: Secure reset and deep clean
settings.text: Devices are cleaned, sanitised and reset so they arrive ready to set up, with the previous owner's data removed.

settings.title: Final grading and approval
settings.text: After final checks we assign the cosmetic grade, confirm the listing details and approve the product for sale.

settings.title: Authentication and hallmark review
settings.text: Each piece is reviewed for authenticity, metal markings and the details that help verify its make and material.

settings.title: Cleaning and polishing
settings.text: We refresh the finish carefully to lift presentation while respecting the character and material of the piece.

settings.title: Stone and structure check
settings.text: Settings, clasps, links and other key points of wear are checked so the piece feels secure and ready to wear.

settings.title: Final wearability and grading
settings.text: Once the finish and structure meet our standards, the piece is given its condition grade and approved for sale.

settings.heading: How we inspect, restore and grade every item
settings.intro: Unboxed restores both everyday tech and pre-loved jewellery with the same careful approach: inspect, test, clean, grade and approve only what meets our standards.
settings.tech_card_heading: Phones, tablets, laptops, gaming gear and wearables that feel ready again
settings.tech_card_text: Every tech item is checked for performance, cleaned, reset and condition graded so customers know exactly what to expect before they buy.
settings.jewellery_card_heading: Refurbished jewellery with finish, security and presentation in mind
settings.jewellery_card_text: Each piece is authenticated, cleaned and checked for structure, wearability and visual finish before it is approved for sale.
settings.process_copy: Tech and jewellery need different specialist checks, but both are cleaned, reviewed and graded carefully before they are listed on site.
settings.explorer_copy: Use the guide below to compare Fair, Good and Like New across smartphones, tablets, laptops, gaming and smartwatches. Jewellery is sold one piece at a time and described individually instead of being grouped into standard grades.
settings.tech_explorer_note: Use this guide to compare cosmetic finish across our tech categories.
settings.tech_quality_note: Every tech grade is fully tested, reset and approved before sale. The difference is cosmetic wear only.
settings.jewellery_one_of_one_text: Every jewellery piece is listed as its own one-off item, with its finish and details described individually rather than assigned to Fair, Good or Like New.
